scope_limits: Only the specified exact-real four-block graph, one coefficient and declared fixed-source/special-eta family are covered; not arbitrary perturbations, all networks or a source-class minimax lower bound.
The coefficient absolute change is 4|eta|; for eta=1/(2q) it is 2/q. Preserve this distinction from score-relative eta.
The fixed-q model is fixed across N. Triangular q_N or safe eta_N sequences change weights with N; perturbation tending to zero separately needs q_N tending to infinity.
A sufficient two-sided exact-output window and a particular positive failing sequence do not establish a sharp threshold, monotonicity, outside-window necessity or an optimal onset exponent.
The unperturbed statistical risk uses inherited R011 proof/review and boundary qualifications; current checks do not independently re-prove it.
Historical candidate-before-review wording is preserved. Separate LLM reviews are neither external human peer review nor formal verification, numerical validation or novelty certification.
Liu and Chen are close antecedents. External URLs are inventoried, not freshly fetched by this audit; differing historical paper-reading limits remain explicit.

No scientific program or archived script was executed, no experiment, simulation, scientific enumeration, model initialization or RNG use occurred. Existing archived execution evidence is not strengthened by this audit.
